prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):

   config: {"story": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "replace": {"intro_story": [{"role": "intro_story", "type": "animation", "asset": "asset:pet_intro_anim", "style": "playful"}, {"role": "intro_story", "type": "text", "text": "Choose how you want to bring your pet to life.", "style": "plain"}]}}}

   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "new_personality", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "pick_friend": {"headline": "Personalize Your Pet's Temperament"}}
2: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In to Onboarding Hand-off: Reorder the sign-in step to occur right after pet generation finishes, immediately before introducing the pet on the desktop.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "sign_in", "home_intro"]}

   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "stage", "notify_when_ready": true, "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "text": "Play while your pet gets ready!", "style": "playful"}, {"type": "timer", "text": "Estimated ready time", "style": "subtle"}]}}

   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Your adopted pet and custom settings are automatically saved to this account.", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Cloud Save Active", "style": "calm"}]}}

   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Free instant retries included until your pet looks exactly how you want!", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "100% Custom Pet Guarantee", "style": "highlight"}]}}
6: [finish, layout] Desktop Interaction Shortcut Checklist Layout: Change the home intro layout to a checklist format outlining primary pet commands like hiding, moving, and chatting.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "checklist", "headline": "How to Interact With Your Pet", "replace": {"home_welcome": [{"role": "home_welcome", "type": "checklist", "text": "Click pet to chat • Drag to move • Double-click tray to hide", "style": "rounded"}]}}}

   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "hint": "Generating 3D mesh and animations for your companion...", "components": [{"type": "progress", "text": "Building 3D Companion...", "style": "emphasis"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning the story screen layout while preserving its job is allowed inside onboarding.
Adding a new pet personality customization screen inside onboarding is allowed.
Reordering sign-in to occur after waiting/adoption is explicitly allowed by rule 4.
Redesigning the waiting screen with interactive mini-games while asset generation takes place is permitted.
Adding a cloud save status hint and badge to the sign-in screen is allowed.
Onboarding copy mentions 'Free instant retries', which violates rule 3 forbidding mentions of prices, discounts, gifts, or free extras.
Updating the home intro layout with an interaction checklist is permitted.
Adding progress indicators and live status updates to the waiting screen is explicitly allowed.
Adding system tray location hints and shortcut tips to the home intro screen is allowed.
Updating choose_path copy while maintaining both adoption options is permitted.
